environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB with TCP passthrough on port 443. No WAF or API gateway in front. The LDAP server (OpenLDAP 2.4.57) is on the same VPC subnet with no query restrictions or ACLs beyond bind authentication. The application runs as a systemd service with network access to the LDAP server on port 389. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to the ELB and ELB-to-instance on 8080.

config.infrastructure: AWS EC2 t3.medium, Classic ELB TCP passthrough
config.ldap_server: OpenLDAP 2.4.57, no query ACLs, anonymous read after bind
config.network: Same VPC subnet, SG allows 389 from app to LDAP
